concept.title: What is the OIT Walk-In Center?
concept.shortdesc: Staff and students can get in-person support for various technology issues at the OIT Walk-In Center.

section.title: The Office of Information Technology Walk-In Center (WIC)
section.p: If you have a technology problem that's easier to explain in person, you can get help at the WIC. Staff are able to help with the following issues:

ul.li: Unity account: including password resets, disabled accounts
Multifactor authentication (MFA): assistance with configuring or troubleshooting Duo

section.ul:
Operating system: including virus and spyware removal
Software: including software installation xref "eduroam and ncsu networks": eduroam and ncsu networks <-->
Network connectivity: including eduroam and ncsu networks
Warranty and hardware repair: For computers and warranties purchased through the NC State Bookstore as well as some manufacturers' warranties

ul.li: Bring your Wolfpack One Card (campus ID card)
Plan to stay at least 20 minutes

Operating hours: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday
Closed on university holidays and when the campus is closed (condition 2) because of adverse weather

Location:
West Dunn Building, Room 101 (Central Campus)
2901 Thurman Dr
Raleigh, NC 27695
Parking: Pay-by-space parking is available in the Dan Allen Deck and the Bragaw parking lot

section.title: Employment
section.p: The Office of Information Technology hires NC State students for part-time jobs in a number of areas.
